proves.claim: keepLease sends one renew call per interval for every job a runner holds, carrying each job and its token, so ten held jobs cost one call.

drive.io-keep-lease.one-renew-for-all-he.why: Ten renew calls per interval per runner loaded the board and slowed every other call.

proves.claim: A claim answer carrying a wait time makes serveRunner wait that time instead of its idle poll.

drive.io-keep-lease.capped-claim-waits.why: A runner at its cap polled claim every 2 seconds and loaded the board for nothing.
